import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Compute correlations and identify near-duplicates
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                to_remove.add(ids[j])
    
    # Build filtered feature set
    keep_ids = [fid for fid in ids if fid not in to_remove]
    if not keep_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    keep_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in keep_ids]
    x_filtered = x[:, keep_indices]
    
    # Select features using mutual information
    mi_scores = mutual_info_classif(x_filtered, y)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(mi_scores)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    selected_ids = [keep_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices if mi_scores[i] > 0]
    
    # For the final model, include all selected features
    columns = tuple(selected_ids)
    
    # Simple weighted score: sum of selected features
    weights = {fid: 1.0 for fid in selected_ids}
    
    # Return design with drivers, columns, products, and loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(selected_ids[:1]),  # Most important feature as driver
        columns=columns,
        products=(),
        loadings=weights
    )
